title: Parse pin files at the commit in kbingest.py
goal: kbingest.py has a pins() reader that takes the survey's kept entries at the commit and returns (file, pin, value) rows for every pin file in agents/codebase-mapping.csv, using tomllib, json, xml.etree and line regexes only; global.json with comments and a .psd1 are read as text, never evaluated; survey --pins prints them; tests named pin_files with planted fixture repositories per language prove each parser and one malformed file per format yields a note, not a crash.
